title: Indian Navy 10+2 B.Tech Cadet Entry January 2027 Online Form Live: 60 Posts Apply Now #IndianNavyBTech2027 #Navy10+2BTech #IndianNavyCadetEntry #NausenaBharti2026 #SarkariNaukri
intro: Join Indian Navy (Nausena Bharti)  has Released Official Notification for Online Application Form for the Post of 10+2 B.Tech Cadet Entry Course Commencing January 2027 Recruitment 2026 for 60 Post.  Check All Details, Like Age Limit, Eligibility Details, Post Information, Pay Scale, Selection Process & More Details Related to Indian Navy 10+2 B.Tech Jobs. Online Application Start on May 29, 2026 & Last Date is June 29, 2026. All Eligible & Interested Candidates Can Read Full Notification Before Apply Online Now in the Given Link Below.
importantDates: Application Online Start:  29 May 2026
Last Date for Registration: 29 June 2026
General / OBC Candidates : N/A
SC /  ST Candidates : N/A
Payment Details: No Application Fee for the All Category Candidates Only Filled the Online Application Form.
Application Online Start:  29 May 2026
Last Date for Registration: 29 June 2026

Passed Senior Secondary Examination (10+2 Pattern) or its equivalent examination from any recognised Board with at least 70% aggregate marks in Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics (PCM) and at least 50% marks in English (either in Class X or Class XII).

Who can Apply. Candidates who have appeared for JEE (Main) - 2026 exam (for B.E/ B. Tech). Call up for Service Selection Board (SSB) will be issued on the basis of JEE (Main) All India Common Rank List (CRL) - 2026 published by NTA.
Minimum Age: 17 Years
Maximum Age: 19.5  Years
Born Between 02 July 2007 to 01 January 2010
Use Age Calculator:  Click Here
Note: -Men and Women (Maximum of 08 vacancies for women, 04 each for Mechanical Engg and Electronics & Communication Engg)
Take 2 Print out of Application Form.
Self Attested Copy of Photograph ,  Class 10,12 Certificates.
Don't Send Application Form.
Old Candidates : No Need to Create New ID Only Use Old ID and Password.
New Candidates : Click on New Registration to Process the Application Form.

Pay Scale:

																
																	
																	During Training: Fixed stipend of ₹56,100/month (Complete 4-year B.Tech degree cost is fully borne by the Indian Navy).
																	
																	
																	On Commissioning (Sub Lieutenant): ₹1,10,000 to ₹1,20,000/month approximate gross salary (Level 10 Basic Pay of ₹56,100 + MSP of ₹15,500 + DA, HRA, and allowances).
During Training: Fixed stipend of ₹56,100/month (Complete 4-year B.Tech degree cost is fully borne by the Indian Navy).
On Commissioning (Sub Lieutenant): ₹1,10,000 to ₹1,20,000/month approximate gross salary (Level 10 Basic Pay of ₹56,100 + MSP of ₹15,500 + DA, HRA, and allowances).

Selection Process:

																
																	
																	Shortlisting: Based on JEE Main Common Rank List (CRL). (Candidate must also have $\ge$ 70% aggregate in PCM in 10+2).
																	
																	
																	SSB Interview: 5-day testing process (Psychological, GTO tasks, and Interview) for shortlisted candidates. No written exam.
																	
																	
																	Medical Test: Medical fitness examination at a military hospital.
																	
																	
																	Merit List: Final selection is prepared strictly based on SSB Marks and medical fitness.
